Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing and certificate-data review of MiTeC Certificate Generator and Certificate Information; no payload or certificate opened

TermsPage.Observation: MiTeC's current support page says trial or unregistered software is freeware for non-commercial usage and describes named-user/build-machine, team, site and trial license types. This does not resolve local intended-use rights or archive redistribution.

Products.Name: MiTeC Certificate Generator
Products.PublishedBehavior: Generates self-signed X.509 certificates in PEM/CER or PKCS#12 PFX formats. The publisher page lists Windows XP-11 and Server 2003-2025; this is not RIDE target acceptance.
Products.LicenseObservation: The product page calls the tool freeware for private, educational and non-commercial purposes.
Products.Acceptance: Use a disposable generated key and certificate only; verify output formats and exact output cleanup. Never inspect or import host keys, use personal certificates, or add a generated certificate to a trust store.

Products.Name: MiTeC Certificate Information
Products.PublishedBehavior: Opens PEM/CRT/CER/P7B/P7C/DER/PFX/P12 certificates, signed portable executables, MSI packages, signed XML and PDF; exports displayed certificates as PEM or DER. The publisher page lists Windows XP-11 and Server 2003-2025; this is not RIDE target acceptance.
Products.LicenseObservation: The product page calls the tool freeware for private, educational and non-commercial purposes.
Products.Acceptance: Use synthetic certificates and signed public fixtures, including a disposable PFX with a test-only key. Verify parsing and export preservation; never open personal/production key containers or export a real private key.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current product versions, publisher-described certificate formats/effects, noncommercial terms and frozen archive/member identities are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local intended-use entitlement and redistribution, certificate parsing/export behavior, generated-key handling and exact cleanup remain unverified.
